verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a cap table product: you can import historical transactions with attached documents, build reports, issue share awards and option grants with vesting schedules, and generate IFRS 2/GAAP equity reports suitable for auditors. The companyCaptable API also exposes cap table data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence for share classes, share certificates and SAFEs/convertibles; investor-facing access to the cap table; independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as a live single source of truth.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on

citations.quote: Bring historical transaction data into your cap table, with documents attached for maximum visibility and accuracy.
Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.
Generate a broad suite of financial reports instantly to account for equity under IFRS 2, UK GAAP or US GAAP, with tranche-level details in one click.
The operation user can retrieve cap table data about the queried company.
